_manual: A place OpenStreetMap does not have yet (a Watsons, say) can be appended by hand: a real surveyed latitude/longitude, one of the categories already used below, a min_zoom (13 = visible from the opening view, 16 = street level only), aliases, and "osm": null. Adding it on openstreetmap.org as well keeps it through the next regeneration.
